thread:
Samir Patel: quick heads-up — opened PR to tweak autoscaling for inference-service and move the secret path into the pod projected volume. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3712  

Diff is small: bump HPA min from 2 -> 4 and add svcaccount annotation for IRSA + projected secret. main worry: VPA interactions and karpenter profile labels. can ppl skim? :eyes:

Anya Gomez: looking now. curious — why move secret to projected volume instead of env? rotation case?

Samir Patel: main reasons: 1) avoids leaking creds in env at container start, 2) easier to rotate without restarting deployment (projected with external-secrets refresh), 3) aligns with pod security policy recommendation.

Lee Chen: quick note about VPA — if we leave VPA updateMode=Auto it can change resources that HPA expects. For this service we should set VPA updateMode: "Off" (or Initial and do manual adjustments). In the PR do you include a VPA annotation?

Samir Patel: not touching VPA in this PR. thought we'd keep VPA unchanged but call out the risk in the PR description.

Jesse Park: also, for karpenter we add profile label and a spot fallback taint? snippet from the k8s patch in the PR:

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: inference-service
  labels:
    karpenter.sh/provisioner: inference-highmem
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: inference-sa
      volumes:
        - name: creds
          projected:
            sources:
              - secret:
                  name: inference-creds
                  items:
                    - key: creds.json
                      path: creds.json
```

Maya Torres: infra-bot just ran terraform plan in the PR — plan shows change: 

infra-bot: "Terraform plan: 1 to update, 0 to add, 0 to destroy. resource: kubernetes_manifest.deployment.inference-service (update)" :lock:

Anya Gomez: ok. two quick checks: 1) Do we need to change HPA target CPU/memory because projected volume slightly changes pod start? 2) are rolloutStrategy parameters (maxUnavailable) set so we don't deplete capacity during scale-down?

Samir Patel: 1) negligible impact on CPU/mem. HPA target remains 60% CPU. 2) rolloutStrategy is RollingUpdate with maxUnavailable: 20% — included in PR.

Lee Chen: I'll run kubeval + kube-score on the patched manifest locally. can someone run a quick smoke on staging after merge? I can watch canary metrics.

Jesse Park: on the secrets wiring — remember external-secrets sync uses cluster role bound to infra-secret-syncer. If you changed path/name we need to update the ext-secret CR too. PR shows ext-secret still pointing at ssm:/prod/inference/creds — confirm that remains the source, only k8s secret name changed?

Samir Patel: correct — external-secret source unchanged. only the k8s manifest namespaced secret structure changed to be projected. added a comment in the PR.

Maya Torres: infra-bot: can we get a brief plan output for the Karpenter provisioner check? infra-bot: "Karpenter provisioner unchanged. No taint or label changes applied to provisioner."

Anya Gomez: sounds good. approved from my side pending Lee's kubeval run. :thumbsup:

Lee Chen: kubeval + kube-score clean. found a minor linter nit (indent), pushed a tiny formatting commit to the PR. Ran a quick scale test in staging (replicas up to 12) — HPA scaled as expected, karpenter provisioner launched new nodes within target AZs. No pod evictions. :shipit:

Samir Patel: awesome — thanks Lee. I'll merge once CI finishes and then Lee can kick off the staging smoke run. tagging @Lee Chen for the smoke.

Jesse Park: recommend we add a short note to runbook about VPA/HPA guidance for this service (updateMode Off) — I'll add an entry after merge.

Samir Patel: perfect. thanks all — merging on green.

infra-bot: "Merge succeeded: infra PR #3712 merged by Samir Patel. CI: all checks passed." :tada:

Samir Patel: merged and rolling out canary now. ping here if anything odd.

Lee Chen: watching canary metrics now, so far latency and error rate stable. will report back in 30m.

Maya Torres: noted for deployment audit. added entry to change log.
